scenes.name: 基礎文法核心詞
scenes.summary: 人稱、指示詞、所有格、情態與助動詞、連接詞——每一句都會用到的高頻詞。
scenes.note: 句子骨架，打錯整句語意就錯了，請優先練熟。

examples: I invited a few of my friends. I’ll be ready in a few minutes.
as good as as soon as possible the same as as well as well as
I can ride a bike. (ability) Can I have one? (request) Can I help you? (offer) It can be cold here in winter. (possibility) You can watch TV now. (permission)
I couldn’t find the information Could you lend me some money? We could go to the cinema tonight.
by herself
by himself
by myself
So, I think it’s right. (conj) He ate too much, so he felt ill. (conj) He wanted to go but he didn’t say so. (adv)

scenes.name: 介系詞與方位
scenes.summary: in / on / at / for / of… 地點、時間、方向與固定搭配都在這裡。
scenes.note: 中文沒有介系詞，是台灣學生最容易漏掉的一類詞。

examples: What about a cold drink? I have about £3. (adv) a book about animals (prep)
The bank’s across the road. He walked across the bridge.
We watched England play against France.
to travel around (adv) to sit around the table (prep)
My email address is david@gmail.com
What’s the weather like? (adv) It’s like an orange but bigger. (prep) I’d like a drink. (v)
over 60 people (adv) to travel all over the world (prep)
In the past, people didn’t have laptops. It’s quarter past twelve.
Manchester United v Liverpool

scenes.name: 常用副詞
scenes.summary: 程度、時間、頻率、方向副詞——讓句子更自然的那一點點東西。
scenes.note: 副詞多半長得像形容詞但位置不同，是拼字練習的大坑。

examples: He’s gone away. It’s two kilometres away.
Just a little bit of cake, please. I’m feeling a bit tired.
Anything else?
How far is the next garage?
First… then… (adv) John came first. (adv) first prize (adj)
First of all, you must wash your hands.
I got a free ticket to the match. Are you free on Saturday?
I’ve just seen Tom. Just a moment.
The train is going to be late. (adj)
I’ll see you later.
at least
Go to the left. (n) left hand (adj) Turn left. (adv)
only once
I only wanted to help. the only one
Are you quite sure? quite old
a straight line (adj) Go straight on. (adv)
Has he arrived yet?

scenes.name: 片語動詞
scenes.summary: get up / look after / turn off… 兩個字合起來才有意義的動詞。
scenes.note: 片語動詞要整個背，不要拆成兩個獨立的字去背。

examples: The car has broken down.
to fill in a form
to get off the bus
to get on the bus
to get up in the morning
Look out – it’s going to fall!
She took off her shoes.
Turn the TV off.
Turn the heating on.
exercise

scenes.name: 動詞：溝通與想法
scenes.summary: say / tell / think / know / understand… 說話與思考的動詞。
scenes.note: 注意 say 與 tell、look 與 see、hear 與 listen 的差別。

examples: Yes, I agree with you. Don’t you agree, Sam?
I suppose so. I suppose you’re right.
Best wishes

scenes.name: 動詞：日常與家務
scenes.summary: clean / carry / open / close / put / take… 每天在做的事。
scenes.note: put / take / get 這組三兄弟的搭配最常考。

examples: She borrowed a book from the library.
a break for lunch (n) Someone’s broken the window. (v)
It’s not clear to me.
I had to cover my eyes. There was a flower on the book’s cover.
I found my keys under the sofa.
May I keep this? Keep right!
We lost the game. I’ve lost my passport.
They cook their own meals.
pack a suitcase
to save money to save time
I’ll take it to your room. It takes three hours.

scenes.name: 動詞：飲食與烹調
scenes.summary: eat / drink / cook / boil / taste… 從廚房到餐桌的動詞。
scenes.note: 可數名詞後面的 eat / have 要用複數，是本場最大陷阱。

examples: We have received your order. You order your meal from the waiter.

scenes.name: 動詞：學校與學習
scenes.summary: learn / study / practise / pass / remember… 學習相關的動詞。
scenes.note: learn 與 study 意思接近但搭法不同，練的時候要一起記。

examples: You pass the station on the left. to pass a driving test
to play football (v) to play the guitar (v) a play at the theatre (n)

scenes.name: 動詞：移動與出行
scenes.summary: go / come / walk / drive / travel / arrive… 移動的動詞。
scenes.note: 方向副詞放句尾（go home、come back）不要放句首。

examples: We came back from our holiday yesterday.
Don’t cross the road here! (v)
Are you going to enter the poster competition?
Please enter through the side door.
in the fall (n) He fell and hurt his leg. (v)
follow somebody on social media
The train leaves at 10 o’clock. I left my bag in the cinema. There isn’t any milk left.
my return from holiday (n) He returned home late. (v) She returned her library books. (v)
I can’t stay long. I stayed in New York for 10 days. The shop stays open late.
The band are on tour this month.

scenes.name: 動詞：感覺與狀態
scenes.summary: become / feel / seem / enjoy / worry… 狀態與感受的動詞。
scenes.note: become 後面接形容詞，get 後面也可接形容詞，兩者常一起出題。

examples: to feel well
You look happy. Don’t look now!
Do you mind if I close the window? I don’t mind if… Never mind. Mind your head!
I’m very pleased for you. (v) Please be quiet!
I prefer football to basketball. I’d prefer to come with you.
She seems happy. It seemed like a good idea.

scenes.name: 動詞：人際與關係
scenes.summary: meet / help / love / marry / join / invite… 跟人有關的動詞。
scenes.note: invite someone to do something 的 to 很容易漏掉。

examples: I’ll give them back to you tomorrow. I’ll give back your books tomorrow.
Call me if you need any help.
Bob and Sam share an office. Will you share your sandwich with me?
She shared her pictures online.
You’re welcome (adj) Welcome to London! (exclam)

scenes.name: 形容詞：形容人
scenes.summary: friendly / clever / honest / shy… 用來說一個人怎樣的形容詞。
scenes.note: -ed 形容被/how的感受，-ing 形容主動/how的感受。

examples: Please be quiet! The restaurant was quiet last night.
She is a very serious person.

scenes.name: 形容詞：形容物
scenes.summary: big / heavy / beautiful / dangerous… 說一樣東西怎樣的形容詞。
scenes.note: 注意 big / large、little / small 這類同義詞的差別。

examples: fresh fruit
hard wood (adj) the homework was hard (adj) to work hard (adv)
a heavy blanket
a short time

scenes.name: 形容詞：性質與程度
scenes.summary: good / better / best、important / possible / usual… 性質與比較。
scenes.note: 比較級與最高級（-er / -est、more / most）是拼字重災區。

examples: (be) bad for somebody
I thought the film was brilliant!
a double room
He swam to the right. (n) your right hand (adj) That’s the right answer. (adj) Turn right here. (adv)
at the same time (adj) Your watch is the same as mine. (pron)
I read a lot in my spare time.
the whole world (adj) the whole of July (n)

scenes.name: 形容詞：情緒與感覺
scenes.summary: exciting / boring / worried / pleased… 描述情緒與感受的形容詞。
scenes.note: 這組多半有 -ed / -ing 兩種形式，要一起記。

scenes.name: 動詞：其他高頻動詞
scenes.summary: 主題表沒列、但日常真的會用到的一批動詞，一次補齊。
scenes.note: 這組多是簡單現在式動詞，練的是 -s / -ed 這兩個尾巴。

examples: The bag belongs to me.
The teacher’s writing on the (black/white) board.
Sorry to bother you.
I’ll call (phone) again later this afternoon. He’s called John. I’m waiting for a call from Anna.
The baby’s crying.
I learnt to dive at the swimming pool.
Excuse me!
I need to take the bus to get back home.
Let’s go to the beach. Let me know when you arrive. My parents let me go to the beach.
It doesn’t matter. (v) What’s the matter? (n)
to post a letter What’s in the post today? to post something online
T hey’re recording a new album.
to have a rest (n) ‘Try to rest,’ the doctor said. (v) the rest of the day (n)
Show me your photos. (v) a film show (n) show somebody round (v)
That sounds nice. To sound good/interesting/strange, etc.
She was standing at the bus stop.
Someone’s stolen my bag!
I like surfing (on) the internet.

scenes.name: 形容詞：其他形容詞
scenes.summary: 把主題表沒列的形容詞補齊，分大小、狀態與感覺三類。
scenes.note: 形容詞拼錯最多的是 -ful / -less / -y 這幾種結尾。

examples: be able to
aged 10 – 16
The walls are an attractive colour.
I was born in Manchester.
Be careful!
Dear Anne,
The flight is delayed.
Hurry, you need to get dressed!
She has fair hair.
I joined a gym to get fit. I run to keep fit.
That’s a strange story!
wild animals

scenes.name: 名詞：動物與昆蟲
scenes.summary: cat / bird / insect / animal… 動物單字與片語。
scenes.note: 動物名詞的複數很多不規則（mouse → mice）。

examples: a baseball bat

scenes.name: 名詞：大自然與天象
scenes.summary: mountain / river / cloud / space / wildlife… 自然景觀與天上的東西。
scenes.note: weather 不可數；談天氣好壞用 good / bad，不用 many。

examples: rock concert

scenes.name: 名詞：身體與健康
scenes.summary: finger / shoulder / stomach / headache… 身體部位與不適。
scenes.note: 身體部位前通常不加定冠詞：my head 疼，不是 my the head。

scenes.name: 名詞：衣物配件（補充）
scenes.summary: 把衣物、鞋襪、配件一次補齊：jacket / jeans / wallet / perfume…
scenes.note: leather / wool / fur / metal 這類材質名詞前通常不加 a。

examples: a pair of boots
I forgot my swimming costume.
He bought her a gold ring. Give me a ring if you’re free. I rang home last night.
He was wearing a grey suit.

scenes.name: 名詞：食物飲品（補充）
scenes.summary: 把食材、菜色與飲料補齊：banana / pasta / steak / lemonade…
scenes.note: 食物名詞通常可數，加 s 就變複數（potatoes）。

examples: egg and chips
fruit jam
My car needs more oil. cooking oil
I suggest having the meeting in the office.

scenes.name: 名詞：居家用品（補充）
scenes.summary: sofa / wardrobe / cupboard / mirror / key… 家具與居家雜物。
scenes.note: equipment、furniture 是不可數名詞，永遠不加 s。

examples: Can you throw the rubbish in the bin?
at the bottom of the stairs
Chicken and chips is my favourite dish. I broke a dish when I was doing the washing up.
You need special equipment to go diving.
The bedrooms are on the first floor. Don’t leave your clothes on the floor.
knife and fork
This is the key to my house. The answer key is at the back of the book.
a bed sheet a sheet of paper

scenes.name: 名詞：學校用品與科目
scenes.summary: pencil / timetable / vocabulary / chemistry… 上學會用到與會學到的。
scenes.note: homework 不可數，不能說 a homework。

scenes.name: 名詞：科技與媒體（補充）
scenes.summary: website / program / printer / social media… 螢幕上的東西。
scenes.note: news 不可數，「一則新聞」要說 a piece of news。

examples: Click on the link.
I found a great website on the net.
a computer program
internet site

scenes.name: 名詞：運動與遊戲（補充）
scenes.summary: player / score / gym / racket / chess… 運動比賽相關名詞。
scenes.note: match、race、game 都是可數名詞，要加 s。

examples: I’ve j oined a diving club.
football match
swimming pool
a running race (n) She raced her brother to the bus stop. (v)

scenes.name: 名詞：人物與職業（補充）
scenes.summary: adult / neighbour / colleague / scientist / celebrity… 各種身分的人。
scenes.note: adult、colleague 是可數名詞，前面要加 a / the。

examples: The band are on tour this month.
She’s a football fan.
a member of a club

scenes.name: 名詞：地點與空間（補充）
scenes.summary: corner / cabinet / entrance / basement / bench… 場所與空間。
scenes.note: place、room 這類詞前面通常要加定冠詞 the。

examples: a tennis court

scenes.name: 名詞：交通與旅行（補充）
scenes.summary: ticket / seat / journey / luggage / traffic… 路上與行程相關的名詞。
scenes.note: luggage 不可數，「一件行李」要說 a piece of luggage。

examples: Use the crossing to cross the street.
The plane was late.

scenes.name: 名詞：金錢與購物（補充）
scenes.summary: coin / change / credit card / discount / customer… 錢與買賣。
scenes.note: money、cash 不可數，要數幾元才用 a dollar、a pound。

examples: for sale I bought it in the sale.

scenes.name: 名詞：時間與月份（補充）
scenes.summary: April / October / o'clock / midday / weekend… 時間與月份。
scenes.note: 月份與星期首字母要大寫；日期用 on，月份用 in。

scenes.name: 名詞：想法與抽象概念
scenes.summary: idea / reason / chance / trouble / success / opinion… 看不見的概念。
scenes.note: 抽象名詞的冠詞要看情況，是學生最容易錯的地方。

examples: Look at the example first. for example
The science experiment was fun.

scenes.name: 日常會話用語
scenes.summary: OK / Wow / Of course / Well done… 真正會用到的固定說法。
scenes.note: 這些多半是固定成句，直接整句背最快。

examples: Pardon?

scenes.summary: 主題表沒有歸類的零散名詞收在一起，方便一次補齊。
scenes.note: 這一組比較雜，建議當成複習清單來過。

examples: I don’t know his age.
Shall we walk round the block?
She wore a gold chain. I need a new bicycle chain.
He was my favourite character in the film.
What’s the name of your company?
dot com

He’s a really nice guy.
Can you turn the heating on?

draw a line the next line
a lot of homework.
My computer has 100GB of memory.
Bob’s the one in the middle of the photo.
a pair of shoes
the best part of the day
a piece of cake
What a pity!
a nice place for a picnic Let’s meet at my place. book a place on a course to take place
pop music
football practice
a birthday present
a TV programme
rap music
What a shame!
this side of the room
That’s where I keep all my stuff.
the top of the page
sport
a pair of trainers
